result.title: Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation
result.summary: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 SAM2 类可提示视频跟踪器在对抗扰动下的鲁棒性，提出白盒攻击 DistractAttack，用背景干扰物制造持续的目标跟踪破坏，其核心反事实干扰物搜索并行传播干净与受攻击轨迹，随时间累积证据以削弱目标支持。
AI.relevance_reason: 通过并行对比干净与受扰轨迹、定位对结果产生因果影响区域并累积证据的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「哪些视觉细节真正支撑内部状态」的诊断设计，但原文面向跟踪鲁棒性而非推理机制。
